findings.text: D12 treats slice 8 as the last contract change for every witness, but owner decision 3 retires each redundant witness after Nix accepts the last change to a contract its proof uses. Fix: Apply that rule in D8 and D12 per witness, and keep unique coverage until a caller or focused test replaces it.

Nix can accept the pilot’s proof of `Sql.check_send_plainInsert` while it still uses `Sql.check_send_of_step`, which D12 then deletes if the witness was its last caller. Fix: Before recording acceptance, reprove each affected witness using only declarations that will remain after cleanup.
